graph.title: LEGO Minecraft 21113-1: The Cave
notes: Piece count reconciles to the 243-piece inventory: 171 explicit parts (b1-b171) plus 6 ring sub-assemblies x 10 parts (60) plus 4 spider leg units x 3 parts (12).
Ids are in build order except b171 (the pickaxe), which is numbered last although it belongs to the Steve minifigure at the start of the booklet.

The booklet builds one main model (the cave, the TNT/grass base and the chest platform), all joined by studs. It also builds four loose items that are not fastened to it: the spider (bag 2 steps 1-8), the bucket with its blue round plate, the loose orange round plate b162, and the pickaxe held by Steve. To avoid isolated groups, these four are tied to the model with 'contact' edges only: spider b99 to base plate b109, bucket b163 to orange plate b71, orange plate b162 to bucket b163, and pickaxe b171 to b109. These contacts are assumptions based on the final picture on p35, where they stand beside the model. They are not real fastenings.

Steve and Zombie minifigure bodies (head, torso, legs, hands) are not in the parts list, so they are not nodes. The pickaxe b171 would attach to Steve's hand, so its contact edge to b109 only stands in for Steve standing next to the base.
The Rebuild Inspiration pages (36-39) reuse the same pieces in other arrangements and add no new parts. They are not modelled.

Placement of many bricks in the steps is read from small isometric pictures. Each 'joined' edge links a piece to the piece it visibly rests on, but the exact studs are uncertain, so most ports are null.

Plate-and-brick sub-assemblies (steps 2, 6, 18 and 24 of bag 2, and bag 3 steps 1-2) are built upside down. Their bricks sit under the plate with brick studs in plate anti-studs, which is how the edges are written.

The ring sub-assembly is built 6 times: 3 in bag 1 step 14 (1 trans-red, 2 pearl gold) and 3 in bag 2 step 6 (2 black, 1 tan). Each is a 2x2 plate, 4 round plates, 4 1x1 plates and a jumper. The layering inside a ring is inferred from the step pictures.
The ring copies attach to different jumpers via attach overrides. Bag 1 rings sit on b38, b37 and b41 and carry b48, b47 and b51. Bag 2 rings sit on b131, b132 and b133 and carry b134, b136 and b137.

Spider legs: the 8 legs are 4 units of 3 parts each (1x2 plate, clip plate, hinge plate). Each unit's two clips hold one arm of a pneumatic T-piece. The step pictures do not make clear which arm each unit clips to, so units 1-2 go on the first T-piece and units 3-4 on the second.
The black 2x2 round plate under the TNT is attached to the base plate b109. The picture does not show which stud it sits on.
The bag 2 base (b109) is attached to the main model only through the two 2x4 bricks b146 and b147 added in step 10.
